audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields (whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0].text, early, wants.foe[0]) attribute a knockup to Bellows Breath (W). Bellows Breath applies Brittle and carries no knockup. The knockup is Searing Charge (E, 14-12s, 450 range) colliding with terrain — and the terrain it needs is usually the magma pillar Volcanic Rupture (Q, 9-7s, 800 range) leaves behind.
audit.why: Riot's text: W is 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle'; E is 'If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave... knocks up enemies'; Q 'a magma pillar forms at the end location'. The mirror audit states the same combo as 'W-brittle + E knockup'. This is the whole reason you stand away from walls and off his pillar.
audit.corrected: Q leaves a pillar, E charges into that pillar or a wall for the knockup, W makes you Brittle. Ryze has no dash, so the pillar is what pins him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 4 and 6 disagree with the packet chart and the mirror. Disk gives Ryze level 1, Ryze level 6 and Ornn 2+ items — but whys[4] itself says level 6 'is still his', and whys[6] plus the late paragraph say two items is the flip in Ryze's favour. Separately diff reads HARD while diffRating (4/10), tone (green) and breakdown.difficulty ('Favoured matchup') all say favoured.
audit.why: 51.77% is a near-even lane that Ryze wins on scaling. The mirror already flipped Level 1 to Skill, Level 6 to Ornn and 2+ items to Ryze as matched pairs; this side must state the same.
audit.corrected: Row 0 Skill, row 4 Ornn, row 6 Ryze as matched full+content pairs, with ratings inverted. diff moved to EVEN so the four difficulty fields stop contradicting each other.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 3 (engage kit complete), 1st item (Iceborn Gauntlet slow field), Lvl 6 (Call of the Forge God, 140/120/100s, dash and knockup flags), 2+ items (Seraph's). Ryze's only owned spike is the last one, which now matches the corrected chart.
audit.corrected: Spike timings untouched; spikes[0].text reworded for the ability error and phases[4].why rewritten to match its new side.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God catches a dashless Ryze on 100-140s — Realm Warp answers maps, not this.

edits.before: You gain Rune Prison but Ornn gains Bellows Breath knockup at the same level, meaning one misread trade can end the even status instantly — respect the knockup before committing W.
edits.after: You gain Rune Prison but Ornn gains Bellows Breath Brittle at the same level, meaning one misread trade can end the even status instantly — respect the debuff before committing W.

edits.before: His full Volcanic Rupture plus Bellows Breath chain is live and can pin you to a pillar before your Flux combo pays out — he dictates trade timing here.
edits.after: His Volcanic Rupture pillar plus a Searing Charge into that terrain knocks you up before your Flux combo pays out — he dictates trade timing here.

edits.before: Ornn completes his engage kit — Volcanic Rupture plus Bellows Breath knockup means one pillar trap near a wall ends the trade before your Flux combo can pay out.
edits.after: Ornn completes his engage kit — the Volcanic Rupture pillar is terrain for Searing Charge, so one knockup near a wall ends the trade before your combo pays out.

edits.before: Land Volcanic Rupture to pin you to a pillar and set up the Bellows Breath knockup before your Phase Rush can proc
edits.after: Land Volcanic Rupture for the pillar, then Searing Charge into it for the knockup before your Phase Rush can proc

edits.before: At level 1 you have only Q, which means you must walk into melee range to poke a champion with better base stats than you — accept a passive opening and use Q tip-range to last-hit rather than trade. At level 2 you gain W (Rune Prison) and your first real threat, but Ornn also hits his W (Bellows Breath) knock-up at level 2, so the even status holds — trade only when his Volcanic Rupture is clearly on cooldown and you can land a clean W-root into empowered Q before he answers. Level 3 tips Ornn's way: his full kit (Volcanic Rupture pillar plus Bellows Breath) can chain-lock you in place, while your Flux combos require standing near him. Play E through the minion beside him rather than walking directly into his face, and start treating every wave near a wall as a potential kill setup for him.
edits.after: At level 1 you have only Q, which means you must walk into melee range to poke a champion with better base stats than you — accept a passive opening and use Q tip-range to last-hit rather than trade. At level 2 you gain W (Rune Prison) and your first real threat, but Ornn also hits his W (Bellows Breath) Brittle at level 2, so the even status holds — trade only when his Volcanic Rupture is clearly on cooldown and you can land a clean W-root into empowered Q before he answers. Level 3 tips Ornn's way: his full kit (Volcanic Rupture pillar plus a Searing Charge knockup into it) can chain-lock you in place, while your Flux combos require standing near him. Play E through the minion beside him rather than walking directly into his face, and start treating every wave near a wall as a potential kill setup for him.

edits.before: Ornn spends Volcanic Rupture early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture is 7-9s, and its pillar is the terrain his Searing Charge needs.

edits.before: That is Ornn’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Bellows Breath applies Brittle — his follow-up hits harder.

notes: The Bellows Breath knockup error appeared in five separate fields and is the same class of mistake as the Brand 'Ares of Blaze' calibration case. Both packet suspectNames ('Volcanic Rupture's', 'Land Volcanic Rupture') are false positives — the name is spelled correctly. The mirror flagged that the kit file tags Bellows Breath as 'projectile', which contradicts Riot's own description of a cone of flame; per the brief's rule I trusted the description and did not write any projectile-blocking claim into this matchup.
